snapshot.text: State-funded Universal Healthcare Programme with mostly private providers; the minister says over 95% of people have access to state-funded services. A full primary healthcare reform starts in 2026, and registration rules for citizens abroad have been tightened.

minister.name: Mikheil Sarjveladze
minister.role: Minister of Labour, Health and Social Affairs

priorities.title: Primary healthcare reform
priorities.text: The primary healthcare reform launches in full from 2026.

priorities.title: Citizens abroad and universal coverage
priorities.text: Universal healthcare registration is suspended for citizens abroad for more than six months.
